parameters.name: EPNInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the EPN instance.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

*   Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
*   If the value of the seconds place is not 00, the start time is automatically set to the next minute.

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the Edge Node Service (ENS) node.

parameters.name: Isp
parameters.description:
The Internet service provider (ISP). Valid values:

*   cmcc: China Mobile
*   telecom: China Telecom
*   unicom: China Unicom
*   multiCarrier: multi-line ISP

parameters.name: NetworkingModel
parameters.description:
The networking mode. Valid values:

*   **SpeedUp**: intelligent acceleration network (Internet)
*   **Connection**: internal network
*   **SpeedUpAndConnection**: intelligent acceleration network and internal network

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The precision of the monitoring data that you want to obtain. Valid values: 300, 1200, 3600, and 14400. Default value: 300. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

*   Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
*   If the value of the seconds place is not 00, the start time is automatically set to the next minute.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-epn-band-width-data --ens-region-id cn-beijing-cmcc --instance-id i-5sg1owx0g4ojy66ab2tez77r2 --start-time 2021-12-15T16:00:00Z --end-time 2021-12-16T16:00:00Z --period 300 --isp cmcc --networking-model SpeedUp --epn-instance-id epn-20200825134537VyK81T --region cn-hangzhou
